# situation: the setting of allowed actions of GitHub allows gradle/* and
#   docker://alpine:*, and blocks gradle/actions/setup-gradle@*. One step,
#   whose if is false, uses gradle/actions/setup-gradle. Another step uses
#   the Docker image busybox, which no pattern allows. Another step uses
#   actions/cache, which no pattern allows.
# reason: GitHub checks each uses before the run starts, also the uses of a
#   step whose if is false, and does not start the run: no job of the run
#   runs (in runs that the authors of the rule made on GitHub, such runs
#   ended as startup_failure).
on: workflow_call
permissions: {}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@ed408507eac070d1f99cc633dbcf757c94c7933a # v4
      - if: false
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@ed408507eac070d1f99cc633dbcf757c94c7933a # v4
      - uses: docker://busybox:1.36
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache
          key: cache-${{ github.sha }}
